scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/web && pip install -r apps/api/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001 --app-dir apps/api" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.test: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green --success all "cd apps/api && pytest -v" "npm --prefix apps/web run test"
